o: A large enough volume of telemetry compensates for gaps and noise in the feeds
Model accuracy depends on complete and reliable input data
Telemetry quality only affects initial training, not models already in production
The algorithms normalize away any errors present in the collected data
fixes.x: A network operations team feeds device telemetry into a machine-learning analytics platform. Which statement about the telemetry data is accurate?
fixes.e: Machine-learning output is only as good as its inputs, so incomplete or noisy telemetry degrades model accuracy during both training and production scoring. Sheer volume cannot compensate for gaps and noise in the feeds, and algorithms cannot simply normalize away collection errors, which is also why quality still matters for models already in production.

o: A colocation facility
An on-premises private cloud
A cloud-based service
A hybrid deployment
fixes.x: A small office subscribes to an email platform from a service provider, and staff reach it over the internet. Which deployment model does this describe?
fixes.e: An application consumed as a subscription from a provider over the internet is the cloud model: the provider owns and maintains the infrastructure while the office simply uses the service. A colocation facility would house server hardware the office itself owns and manages, and a hybrid deployment would combine the provider's service with infrastructure the office still runs, neither of which fits a pure subscription offering.

o: On the Security tab, within the Layer 2 sub-tab
On the Security tab, within the Layer 3 sub-tab
On the Security tab, within the AAA Servers sub-tab
On the General tab, beside the profile name field
fixes.x: Where in the WLC GUI's WLAN configuration is the WPA2 pre-shared key entered?
fixes.e: WPA2 with PSK is a Layer 2 security method, so the key is entered on the Security tab's Layer 2 sub-tab. The Layer 3 sub-tab covers web authentication policies and the AAA Servers sub-tab links the WLAN to RADIUS servers, so neither holds the pre-shared key; the General tab only handles naming and status.

o: It ensures DHCP leases renew before their timers expire
It keeps log timestamps and certificate checks consistent between devices
It shortens routing protocol convergence by aligning hello timers
It updates interface traffic counters at a higher resolution
fixes.e: Synchronized clocks let administrators correlate log timestamps across devices and keep time-sensitive certificate validation accurate. DHCP lease renewal, routing protocol hello timers, and interface counters all run on each device's own internal timers, so NTP accuracy does not change how they behave.

o: The Time To Live field in the IPv4 header
The Differentiated Services field in the IPv4 header
The Protocol field in the IPv4 header
The Flags field in the IPv4 header
fixes.x: Which header field is used to mark IP packets so routers can apply per-hop priority treatment?
fixes.e: Per-hop priority markings are carried in the Differentiated Services field, which every router along the path can read to classify and queue the packet consistently. The Time To Live field limits hop count, the Protocol field identifies the payload such as TCP or UDP, and the Flags field controls fragmentation; none of them signals priority.

o: ARP spoofing used for on-path interception
MAC flooding of the switch address table
DHCP starvation of the address pool
Gratuitous ARP floods meant to overwhelm the switch CPU
fixes.e: DAI validates ARP packets against DHCP snooping bindings specifically to stop the forged replies that enable on-path interception. Gratuitous ARP floods against the switch CPU are a volume problem absorbed by ARP rate limiting rather than the inspection logic itself, while MAC flooding is countered by port security and DHCP starvation by DHCP snooping.

o: Set the server access port to untrusted mode
Add a static ARP entry for the server on the neighboring router
Define an ARP ACL binding its IP to its MAC
Disable DHCP snooping globally for the VLAN
Apply an ARP ACL to the VLAN for inspection
fixes.e: A statically addressed host has no DHCP snooping binding, so an ARP ACL supplies the valid IP-to-MAC pair and must be applied to the VLAN that DAI inspects. A static ARP entry on the neighboring router only populates that router's own cache and never reaches the switch's inspection logic, and disabling DHCP snooping removes bindings without exempting the server's traffic.

o: Faster WAN circuits installed at each branch office
A larger team of technicians configuring each router
Standardized machine-driven provisioning replacing manual steps
Extended weekend maintenance windows for installation work
fixes.x: An organization begins provisioning new branch routers in hours instead of weeks after overhauling its deployment process. Which change most directly produced this improvement?
fixes.e: Standardized machine-driven provisioning executes the same validated steps on every router in minutes, which is what collapses deployment lead time from weeks to hours. Faster WAN circuits and additional technicians only accelerate parts of a still-manual workflow, and extended maintenance windows change when the work happens, not how long it takes.

o: The management plane used for device administration
The control plane that makes forwarding decisions
The data plane that moves packets between interfaces
The application plane where network services express intent
fixes.x: In a software-defined network, which plane is separated from the individual switches and routers and centralized on a controller?
fixes.e: SDN centralizes the control plane, the decision-making logic, on a controller while each device retains its data plane to move packets between interfaces. The management plane still refers to per-device administrative access such as SSH and SNMP, and the application plane sits above the controller consuming its northbound APIs; neither is what gets pulled out of the switches and routers.

o: Baselining normal traffic to highlight unusual behavior
Approving emergency change requests without human review
Predicting the exact moment a stable link will fail
Correlating many alerts into a single probable root cause
Guaranteeing the true root cause from one isolated alert
fixes.e: AI-assisted operations excel at pattern analysis, such as baselining normal traffic to expose anomalies and correlating large alert volumes into a probable root cause. The technology produces probabilities rather than certainties, so guaranteeing the true root cause from one isolated alert or predicting the exact moment a stable link will fail overstates it, and approving emergency changes without human review removes necessary oversight.

o: Unicast
Broadcast
Anycast
Multicast
Loopback
fixes.e: In IPv6, multicast provides one-to-many delivery to every member of a group, and anycast provides one-to-nearest delivery, reaching only the closest member of a group. Broadcast is the tempting one-to-all choice, but IPv6 eliminated broadcast entirely in favor of multicast; unicast and loopback each reach exactly one interface.

o: CDP
STP
ARP
LLDP
fixes.x: An engineer wants directly connected Cisco devices to exchange identity, platform, and port information at Layer 2 without adding any configuration. Which protocol provides this?
fixes.e: CDP is Cisco proprietary and enabled by default, advertising identity, platform, and port details to directly connected neighbors. LLDP carries the same kind of neighbor information but is the open standard and is disabled by default on most Cisco platforms, while STP prevents Layer 2 loops and ARP resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses.

o: FlexConnect mode
SE-Connect mode
Monitor mode
Sniffer mode
fixes.e: FlexConnect lets a controller-joined AP switch client traffic locally at the branch, so users keep working if the WAN link to the controller fails. Monitor and sniffer modes dedicate the radio to scanning or packet capture and serve no clients, and SE-Connect streams spectrum-analysis data rather than forwarding user traffic.

o: Monitor mode
Local mode
Rogue detector mode
FlexConnect mode
Sniffer mode
fixes.e: Local mode is the standard client-serving mode, and FlexConnect also serves clients while adding the ability to switch their traffic locally at a branch. Monitor, sniffer, and rogue detector modes dedicate the AP to scanning, packet capture, or wired-side detection, so none of them carries client traffic.

o: Syslog
CDP
LLDP
SNMP
NTP
fixes.e: CDP and LLDP both advertise and learn directly connected neighbor details such as device identity, platform, and port, with LLDP as the vendor-neutral IEEE standard. SNMP polls devices for statistics, Syslog forwards event messages to a collector, and NTP synchronizes clocks; none of those protocols carries neighbor information.
